producer_report.summary: I wrote docs/design/records-history.md, added D112 (Proposed) to docs/decisions.md, and added one Added bullet to CHANGELOG.md. There is no code or configuration change. The design recommends a records branch in this repository (`refs/athena/records`, a separate root, never merged into main). In D72 stealth mode the same branch lives in a local bare repository. It compares that against a second repository and a database on A4, A5 and D72. It covers copy-with-manifest migration, a frozen legacy rule for the six exempt entries and 02837e0, and attribution from records written after the merge. It also covers the pull-request-level squash rule, reachability by giving each landing record commit the PR head as a second parent, and the guarantees table with where each is enforced now. Crash reconciliation (local first, host as fallback), compare-and-swap with retry for parallel writers, the checkpoint and weekly full replay with a measurement plan, an eight-job build plan, and the reversal cost are also in the document.

criteria_check.criterion: docs/design/records-history.md compares at least three options (records branch with a separate root in this repo, a second repository, a database), each weighed against BRIEF.md A4, A5 and D72, and recommends exactly one with reasons.
criteria_check.evidence: Section 3 has a table with all three options against A4, A5 and D72, followed by one Recommendation (records branch) with reasons.

criteria_check.criterion: The design migrates every existing record, states what happens to records/ on main afterwards, and how the history check treats commits before the cutover (including the six [history] exempt entries and 02837e0).
criteria_check.evidence: Section 4: import with a manifest of paths and hashes plus a self-check, records/ on main frozen then removed in a late job, and a frozen legacy rule listing the six exempt shas and 02837e0.

criteria_check.criterion: The design attributes each main commit from records alone, with no commit-message trailers: it names the records written after the merge (PR head, host-made commit), gives the pull-request-level squash rule, and says how PR commits stay reachable without the host.
criteria_check.evidence: Sections 5.3 and 6: the landing record names the PR head and the host-made commit; the squash rule is stated at PR level; section 6.1 gives reachability through the second parent on the records commit.

criteria_check.criterion: A table lists each current guarantee (append-only, nothing unverified reaches main, prediction precedes outcome, secrets and personal data) with where it is enforced after the change.
criteria_check.evidence: Section 7 table, with rows for append-only, nothing unverified, prediction precedes outcome, secrets, and personal data.

criteria_check.criterion: The design covers crash reconciliation between host merge and record write, and parallel writers to the records history.
criteria_check.evidence: Sections 5.2, 8.1 and 8.2: landing-intent, local-first matching with host fallback, bounded pending state, compare-and-swap, replay and retry.

criteria_check.criterion: The design makes the check's cost depend only on commits new since the last passing state, with a periodic full replay, and says how this is measured against today's ~65 s / ~4,000 records.
criteria_check.evidence: Section 9: checkpoint record, judging only what is new, weekly and verifier-version full replay, and a four-step measurement plan against the reported figures.

criteria_check.criterion: The design gives an ordered build plan of jobs, each sized for one producer run, in which main is never unattributed, and states the reversal cost.
criteria_check.evidence: Section 10 (eight jobs, each with a test statement, and the ordering argument) and section 11 (reversal cost by stage).

criteria_check.criterion: docs/decisions.md has a new entry with status Proposed (not Accepted) summarising recommendation and alternatives, in the file's existing format and numbering; no existing entry is altered.
criteria_check.evidence: D112 appended after D111 in the Case/Decision/Alternatives/Tradeoff/Reversal cost/Provenance format, with the Decision starting 'Proposed, design only'. The edit only added lines at the end.

criteria_check.criterion: No code or governance files change: run git diff --stat and confirm it lists only docs/design/records-history.md, docs/decisions.md and CHANGELOG.md (no athena.toml, defaults.toml, workflow or Rust files).

open_issues: The assumption that the user's host accepts pushes of refs/athena/* is unchecked. It is stated in the design as a check for job 1.
The 65 s and 4,000 figures are reported in the request. I did not measure them.
The pending-window length, the cutover commit C0 (and whether 02837e0 falls before it), and the wait before the records/ removal job are left for Sri to set.
The design does not name which commit is C0.
I did not read the crates/athena-gate source, as the plan said to. That source is the part of the check logic this document describes.
